summary: Frontend-only bug-fix verification for Aprendizagens essenciais (Config). All 4 review points confirmed working against phase2test@teste.pt / Matemática 7A on the public URL. (1) Save button starts ENABLED with 3 existing rows, becomes DISABLED right after clicking 'Adicionar aprendizagem' (empty name), and immediately becomes ENABLED after typing a name in comp-nome-{new_idx} — this is the exact bug fix (validation now only checks uniqueness of NON-EMPTY codes + all names filled). (2) After clicking 'Guardar aprendizagens', the aprendizagem persists across a full page reload (auto-assigned AE code applied). (3) Import modal opens from comp-import-btn, pasted 2-line CSV ('TEST_AEX1, ...\nTEST_AEX2, ...') → preview count correctly shows '2 aprendizagem(s) detetada(s)', submit is enabled, modal auto-closes ~1.2s after import, and both new items persist after reload (total row count went from 4 → 6). (4) No regression observed on other Config sections (Semestres shown at 100% Válido, page renders normally).
critical_code_review_comments: Config.js CompetenciasSection: `handleImport` merges + immediately calls saveAprendizagems, but does NOT catch/display errors (unlike save()). If PUT /api/turmas/{id}/competencias fails during import, the modal will surface the error via its own try/catch and message. Fine but slightly inconsistent.

CompetenciasImportModal.parseTable: header detection uses `codeIdx >= 0 || nomeIdx >= 0` — if a user pastes 2 columns without header, first-row is treated as data (code,nome). Works for the review's test case but subtle. Existing behaviour, not a regression.

AprendizagemsImportModal auto-code generator does not consider codes that appear later in the `items` array (only `existing` + previously generated). In practice items rarely have their own codes if not from CSV headers, so no observed collision — but a defensive fix could pre-populate existingCodes with `items.map(c=>c.code).filter(Boolean)` too.
seed_data_creation: Added 3 TEST_-prefixed aprendizagens to the phase2test turma: TEST_it9_bug_verify_3 (via manual add + save, auto-coded AEn), and 2 more via CSV import (codes TEST_AEX1, TEST_AEX2). Total went from 3 → 6 rows. These remain in the turma and are visible as TEST_-prefixed items for manual removal if needed.
